actual_scope: Compact exact universal-substitution certificates and explicit matrix counterexamples for complete dirty linear programs over Q, Q(i) or prime fields, including literal pinned echo scheduler adapters.
scope_change_reason: The user explicitly requested a high-leverage reusable result rather than a kappa increase. This replaces a single Lean interface formalization with a written generic bridge, reusable certificate tools, and source-bound applications. No Lean or full theorem formalization is claimed.
bottleneck_link: Repeated dirty-connector, cleanup and tensor-lift work needs universal operator identities. A small invariant-subspace certificate closes this algebraic obligation without exponential word expansion or extrapolating from small matrices.
stop_rule: Stop after the compact compiler and closure theorem, a separate no-elimination checker, a real pinned scheduler adapter, explicit failure witnesses and bounded semantic controls. Do not expand to relation-aware or physical/native admission.
evidence: PROOF.md; 210 source-echo identities; 120 explicit-word differential circuits; 180 literal matrix counterexamples; malformed certificate/input and characteristic controls; committed examples; exponential 2^64-support case using 130 states and 65 closure rows.
